items.title: Fred Lipsius interviewed by Monk Rowe. Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: I show students, “Look, a good lick, Miles Davis played [scats]”

ctx.x: You can play or think a few measures ahead?

[Scats] You know I just keep going. And it’s not about playing a lot of notes but I can do that and I show students, “Look, a good lick, Miles Davis played [scats]” — it sounds hip but it’s just as good as playing twenty notes. The other weird thing for me, and again I’m not bragging about it I just told a few people, if they even understand, something happened to me. You get older and things change, just life experience, I can’t even explain it. But maybe in the last ten years, I can’t even measure that. I can…
Do you think that’s more up in your head than it is figures?
